branch_design.branch_request_reconstruction: each branch request is the frozen pre-read body with visible_messages set to the envelope text (real/placebo) or [] (null); request hashes are frozen per event and recomputed by the verifier
branch_design.execution_order: frozen in branch_schedule: event-major over the #192 decision order with one counterbalanced permutation per event; the future runner must fail closed on any deviation
branch_design.no_ling_calls: real messages come from the frozen #192 event set and placebo is controller-injected; replay needs no Ling call
branch_design.placebo: C plus serialize_placebo_message(a receiver-already-known clue of A with authoritative I_m = 0 and no feasible-set reduction); synthetic origin stays controller-side
branch_design.pre_read_state: one identical model-visible C per event: the receiver-A pre-read state (family, complexity, agent_id, clues) with the registered model, question id, instructions and criteria; prompt_form_id equals the frozen #189/#192 form id
branch_design.real: C plus serialize_message(the exact accepted B-owned claim selected by #192)

branch_schedule.assignment_rule: per-event permutation = BRANCH_PERMUTATIONS[(lexicographic form index + within-form event index) % 6]; depends only on frozen form and event identity, never on outcomes
branch_schedule.execution_order: events in #192 decision order; the three branches of one event are executed adjacently before the next event

ling_budget.justification: no Ling call exists in the replay design: real messages are taken from the frozen #192 event set, the placebo is controller-injected, and only the Jev receiver is called

caps.next_call_reservation_arithmetic: 0.000344064 x (1 + max_retries 2) = 0.001032192 reserved before each logical branch

planned_calls.arithmetic: 17 events x 3 branches (real/placebo/null) = 51 Jev receiver calls; the replay design makes no Ling call

provider_partition.arithmetic: 51 x (1 + registered max_retries 2) = 153 physical Jev attempts (retry-inclusive ceiling)

claim_scope.statement: conditional on the six frozen planning-low forms and the paid Ling route that generated the messages; locking is not live authorization; fresh instance IDs never increase k

estimand.form_contrast: mean of d_i within prompt form f

null_branch.excluded_from: the algebraically cancelling primary real-versus-placebo contrast

estimand.primary: Delta = equal-weight mean over the six frozen forms of the within-form mean of H_real - H_placebo
unit_notes: the 17 events are replicates within six prompt forms, not 17 independent states
repeated instances inside a form are averaged, never treated as independent units
no instance-level t-test or Wilcoxon test may be used as primary inference

immediate_terminal_stops: request cap or cost cap before the next call

journal.branch_order_persistence: both planned and actual branch order are persisted per row and per event; a runner must fail closed if actual execution order differs from the frozen branch_schedule
journal.durability: append, flush, and fsync after every logical branch outcome
journal.partial_triplets: partial triplets must remain observable rather than being lost
journal.report_grouping: the final report groups branch rows into event-level real/placebo/null records for the registered replay validator and inference
journal.row_unit: one durable row per logical (event_id, branch) execution

nonterminal_invalidity.band: an accepted transport response outside the primary normalization band but within the registered suspect sensitivity band
nonterminal_invalidity.policy: recorded invalid with its safe raw diagnostics retained; never reinterpreted as valid; continue unless a registered terminal rule applies

output_lifecycle.fresh_execution_after_partial_run: a fresh execution after a partial/stopped run requires a new review and explicit authorization

per_branch.complete_pair: an event is a primary complete pair only when real and placebo are both valid
per_branch.cost_reservation: reserve the registered retry-inclusive worst-case next-call cost (0.001032192 USD) before each logical branch
per_branch.nonterminal_invalid: a nonterminal invalid branch is journaled and does not cause the remaining branches in that event to be skipped
per_branch.null_validity: reported separately and not required for the primary real/placebo pair
per_branch.retries: registered retryable transport statuses only, maximum two

preflight: exact reviewed registration hash and repository-backed verification
model, endpoint, codec, protocol key, retry and normalization settings
request, state, option and treatment hashes
credentials present but never printed or retained
no provider call before every preflight check passes

provider_failures.reset: the consecutive-failure count resets after a successful valid response
provider_failures.retention: never retain response bodies or credentials
provider_failures.retry_exhaustion: record a sanitized invalid branch row

execution_policy.stopping_report: stopping preserves a partial report with planned/attempted/valid/invalid/unattempted counts by branch, event, and form

formulas.computation_rule: compute all metrics only from the accepted normalized vector
formulas.mass_SA: sum of the normalized Choice probabilities over the frozen authoritative pre-read feasible_set for receiver A
formulas.reporting_rule: report guard values per event and aggregate them within form; guards never remove an otherwise valid real/placebo pair from the primary entropy estimate; entropy reduction alone is never called useful uptake when either guard fails; null remains excluded from these primary real-versus-placebo guards

guards.reference_set: the frozen authoritative pre-read feasible_set for receiver A, stored and hashed per event
guards.reporting: reported separately by form and event; never used to filter the primary entropy estimate
guards.useful_uptake_rule: an entropy reduction alone must never be labeled useful uptake if the target-probability guard fails

inference.direction_requirement: the observed equal-form mean must be negative
inference.primary_test: exhaustive two-sided cluster sign-flip over the six form means
prohibited_as_primary: treating the 17 events as independent states

conditional_on: the six frozen planning-low prompt forms
the paid Ling route that generated the messages
limitations.k_cap: k is capped at six by the generator's closed form space; fresh instance IDs cannot increase k
limitations.mde_context: the planning-context approximate detectable-effect / confidence-interval limitation is about 0.203 bits (t(0.975,5) x 0.1933 / sqrt(6))
limitations.null_result: a null result cannot exclude effects smaller than roughly 0.2 bits

missingness.complete_pair: a primary event pair is complete only when real and placebo are both valid
missingness.five_form_fallback: interval-only descriptive reporting; a two-sided sign-flip p below 0.05 is forbidden; no causal gate is released
missingness.primary_requirement: at least one complete real/placebo pair in every one of the six frozen forms
missingness.report: planned, attempted, valid, invalid and complete pairs by branch and by form

invalidity.raw_vector_retained_on_invalid: when safe (finite); non-finite values are encoded as strings

renormalization.exact_tier_rescale: within 1e-6; usually a numerical no-op but applied for one invariant

not_normalized_hard.role: invalid; triggers the registered hard stop

pending_decisions: locking this registration does NOT authorize #159 execution; live replay requires a separate review and explicit live authorization after this lock is approved

event_source.collection_statement: Fixed N=36 was not completed: collection stopped at case 32 under a registered terminal rule. The v7 block is a registered partial run and cannot be described as a completed fixed-N sample.
event_source.coverage_statement: Six-form replay coverage passed within a registered partial run; fixed-N collection completeness failed.

provenance.partial_run_note: the incomplete 32/36 v7 collection is NOT a completed fixed-N sample; this registration consumes its frozen event set as-is

purpose: amend and lock the #159 matched real/placebo/null Jev replay plan on top of the coverage-qualified #192 event set, without rerunning collection

runner_policy.live_execution_rule: this registration lock is not live authorization; live execution requires the source-bound runner plus a separate explicit authorization
runner_policy.policy: the #195 replay runner is implemented in src/apart_incident_response/jev_replay_runner_v4.py and included in REPLAY_V4_SOURCE_FILES; adding the runner does not authorize execution — live execution still requires a separate explicit authorization

superseded_offline_lock.note: pre-runner offline lock; original content preserved in git commits d97a459 and a2a9e31; superseded by this runner-bound amendment

sensitivity.rule: secondary sensitivity only; a secondary analysis never overrides the primary result

successor_of.note: v1-v3 registrations and all prior journals/reports are never modified, resumed, pooled with, or reinterpreted; v4 uses fresh paths only
